major_cooldowns.name: Zenith
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Two charges let you bank one, so spend it on Bloodlust, stat trinkets or an Invoke Xuen window rather than on sight: it resets Rising Sun Kick, hands you 2 Chi, cuts every Chi spender by 1 and makes Blackout Kick your free filler for 15 seconds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1249625 is both the cast and the self-aura id in the sampled parse. Tooltip gives a 1.5 min recharge with 2 charges; talents can bring it to 60, 70 or 80 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it inside Zenith and after Invoke Xuen, spaced away from Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch so its Heart of the Jade Serpent does not overwrite the one those casts give you.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it as the setup for Celestial Conduit and the Zenith window that follows, planning a GCD ahead so you are not summoning Xuen when you want to be attacking.

major_cooldowns.name: Strike of the Windlord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it high in the priority inside Zenith, but not while the Celestial Conduit instance of Heart of the Jade Serpent is still running, since the two do not stack.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parse but name-verified as a real castable ability.

major_cooldowns.name: Whirling Dragon Punch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it as soon as its window opens, above Tiger Palm in the priority and inside Zenith, and keep it staggered against Celestial Conduit so their Heart of the Jade Serpent buffs do not collide.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 152175 is the cast id; 196742 is the self-aura and 158221/451767 share the name.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as soon as it is up whenever it does not delay a bigger ability, after Fortifying Brew where possible since it snapshots your maximum health, and against a target holding less health than your maximum for the full-damage version.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Start the 2 second channel before the pull, then line later uses up within 2 seconds of Invoke Xuen so its Mastery buff covers the Zenith burst window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket rather than a talent; talent_gated is set so builds without it are not scored as missing casts.

defensives.name: Touch of Karma
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it into predictable damage to absorb up to 50% of your maximum health for 10 seconds and redirect 70% of it back at the target, and press Fortifying Brew first since the absorb snapshots your maximum health.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Take 20% less damage for 15 seconds, and where the damage pattern allows, use it just before Touch of Karma or Touch of Death so both snapshot the raised maximum health.
defensives.id_note: 115203 is the cast id; the guide links the talent node 388917 and 120954 is the self-aura.

defensives.name: Expel Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Spend 15 Energy on it to clear chip damage between mechanics instead of banking it, since the 15 second cooldown returns well before the next hit.
defensives.id_note: 322101 is the 15 second cast id per its tooltip; 115129 and 451968 share the name and were not observed as casts.

rules.description: Opener: Tiger Palm, Zenith, Fists of Fury, Rising Sun Kick
rules.action: Open with Tiger Palm to reach 4 Chi, then Zenith with your potion, racial and stat trinket already rolling, then Strike of the Windlord, Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick.

rules.description: Hit Combo up: never repeat the same ability
rules.action: Never press the same ability twice in a row: each new ability adds a Hit Combo stack up to 5 and takes the 19% Mastery: Combo Strikes bonus with it.

rules.description: Spend Dance of Chi-Ji with Spinning Crane Kick
rules.action: Cash every Dance of Chi-Ji proc into a free Spinning Crane Kick, and send it once it has under 4 seconds left rather than risking a second proc overwriting the stack.

rules.description: Spend Blackout Kick! procs with Blackout Kick
rules.action: Consume Blackout Kick! with a free Blackout Kick. It banks 2 stacks, so at 2 stacks press it before the next Tiger Palm overwrites one.

rules.description: Tiger Palm to refill Chi, never at the cap
rules.action: Press Tiger Palm below 4 Chi, under 2 stacks of Blackout Kick! and when Energy is about to cap. At high Chi its generation is wasted, and during Zenith it is not your filler at all.
Only channel Celestial Conduit while Zenith is up and you hold more than 1 Chi, and hold it until Heart of the Jade Serpent has under 4 seconds left or is down.
Summon Invoke Xuen first, then channel Celestial Conduit inside the Zenith window it sets up. The window after Xuen is long, so do not burn a GCD on Xuen mid-burst.

source_summary: Windwalker is built around Zenith, a two-charge 15 second window that resets Rising Sun Kick, hands over 2 Chi, cuts every Chi spender by 1 and turns Blackout Kick into free filler, so it is banked for Bloodlust, stat trinkets and Invoke Xuen rather than pressed on sight. Conduit of the Celestials builds open Invoke Xuen into Zenith and then channel Celestial Conduit, staggering it against Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch so the Heart of the Jade Serpent instances do not overwrite each other. Everything else is priority play: keep Combo Strikes unbroken, cash Dance of Chi-Ji and Blackout Kick! procs before they overstack, and refill Chi with Tiger Palm without capping Chi or Energy.
